blocks.body: # ICP UNO 500-Epoch Four-Model Portable Execution Specification

## The protocol is frozen, isolated, and ready for implementation hand-off

The study trains formal SDF, formal Dimension, ABC-SDF, and an architecture-matched ABC-Dimension-P control for 500 completed epochs each. It reserves separate paths, forbids writes into adopted v45/v46 assets, and defines evaluation, two optimization tracks, COMSOL confirmation, recovery and nine conference figures. Existing measurements imply about 105-108 hours of pure sequential training and five to six days for the full workflow. This document records specifications only; it does not claim that the 500-epoch runs have started or completed.

## The ABC comparison isolates structure information rather than model capacity

ABC-SDF receives actual structure maps and actual-structure unit-current vacuum fields. ABC-Dimension-P replaces the five structure maps with five broadcast dimensions and derives its four vacuum-field channels only from the regular geometry reconstructed from those dimensions. Both ABC models keep two process conditions, fourteen spatial channels, the same adaptive local/global UNO and an asserted equal parameter count.

## Sequential execution is required for reproducible timing and GPU state

Run one model at a time in the listed order. The estimates below are planning values, not completed 500-epoch measurements; the final report must replace them with recorded elapsed time.

## The evidence population and metrics are fixed before training

All models use the same 957-case dataset and 685/136/136 split. The structural test contains exactly 75 unknown structures and 25 matched regular anchors. Primary audience-facing measures are physical ion-density relative L2, wafer Bohm-profile relative L2, Bohm-uniformity error, and unknown-minus-anchor structural response. COMSOL response arrays may be used as truth only and never as model inputs.

## Optimization is split into matched and expressive design spaces

Track A lets all four models search the same regular five-dimension family under one budget and one feasibility definition. Track B lets SDF models search independent coil placement, height and size while Dimension models remain a regular-layout reference. The top distinct candidates must be rerun in COMSOL; surrogate rankings alone do not establish an optimization result.

## Conference figures lead with fields, Bohm profiles, and all-case distributions

The required figure set starts with a direct geometry/COMSOL/four-model field comparison, then shows wafer Bohm profiles and the error distribution over all 75 unknown cases. Family, structural-response, learning-curve and optimization figures provide robustness and mechanism checks. No result figure is included here because the 500-epoch runs do not yet exist.

## Limitations remain visible

This is a one-seed high-budget comparison, not a seed-variance study. The workspace contains uncommitted implementation state, so Git HEAD alone cannot reproduce it. ABC input semantics require a declared initialization mapping. Five-day runs also require optimizer, scheduler and RNG recovery checkpoints before execution.

## Next step: implement the isolated launcher, prove resume equivalence, then start training

The receiving environment should first transfer and hash the complete source snapshot, implement the v47-only launcher and ABC-Dimension-P feature provider, pass model and stop/resume smokes, and verify every output path. Only after these gates pass should the four 500-epoch jobs run sequentially.

## Questions the completed run must answer

Does ABC-SDF improve both unknown ion-density and Bohm-profile error without a family regression? Does a longer schedule improve validation behavior rather than only training loss? Do surrogate-selected structures remain superior after COMSOL confirmation? If any answer is negative, the final report must retain that result rather than promote the model.
